第11章 王家闹鬼-《城隍是我老祖，原来我是神N代》

老爷子的话，让吴姜愣了一下，前一段时间还听他的同学靳欢欢说过这事，难道现在还没解决吗？

“我听说了，不过他那么有钱，请不到有真本事的？”

“嗐，怎么没请人？”老爷子叹了口气，摇了摇头，“前段时间才从山上请了一个道士下来，可也没解决。那道士说，这事得他师傅出马才行，可他师傅出去云游了，暂时联系不上，王积友一家现在都快急疯了。”

吴姜狐疑地看了老爷子一眼，他怎么知道的这么清楚。

老爷子看出了他的疑惑，笑着解释道：“王积友那小子，以前是我教过的学生，为人还算不错，每年都来看看我这个老头子。这不，他家这事现在闹得沸沸扬扬，我就给他打了一个电话，听他在电话里哭诉的。”

顿了一下，老爷子接着说道：“我想的是你现在不是在地府上班吗，过去看看能不能解决。解决不了再看能不能从下面摇人，要是真能解决了，王积友那家伙还能少了你的好处？”

吴姜听了爷爷的话，琢磨了片刻，也就点头答应了。他也挺好奇的，到底是什么鬼，会缠着王首富的儿子，也没听说，王首富的儿子是个纨绔啊。

“那行，我现在就给王积友打个电话。”老爷子也不磨叽，立马掏出手机，翻出王积友的号码，直接拨了过去。

这事，宜早不宜迟，拖得越久，恐怕越麻烦。

“王积友马上派车来接我们，他也是死马当活马医了，小姜，你到了以后就胡乱编一下，就说上学的时候拜了一个道士当师傅，学了一些本事，阴差的事就别透露了，记住没？”

吴姜立刻答应，他也不想贡献点再被扣了，谁知道再犯的话，会不会有更严重的处罚，到时候哭都没地方哭。

没过二十分钟，王家派来的车就到了，还是王老板的专属座驾，一辆黑色的迈巴赫，低调又奢华。

司机恭敬地从车上下来，快步走到门口，客客气气地将老爷子扶到了后座，又恭敬地请吴姜上车。

吴姜也不讲究，直接坐上了副驾驶，一路上，有一搭没一搭地跟司机聊着天，本来想趁机打听点王家的情况，可谁知道，司机的嘴特别严，不管吴姜怎么旁敲侧击，他都只是含糊其辞。

吴姜见状，也不再多问，索性靠在椅背上，闭目养神。

The old man's words made Wu Jiang stunned for a moment. He heard his classmate Jin Huanhuan talk about this matter some time ago. Hasn't it been resolved yet?

"I heard about it, but he is so rich, why can't he hire someone with real skills?"

"Hey, why didn't you invite anyone?" The old man sighed and shook his head, "I just invited a Taoist priest from the mountain some time ago, but it didn't solve the problem. The Taoist priest said that his master had to take action, but his master went out to travel and couldn't be contacted for the time being. Wang Jiyou and his family are going crazy now."

Wu Jiang glanced at the old man suspiciously, wondering how he knew so clearly.

The old man saw his doubts and explained with a smile: "That boy Wang Jiyou was a student I taught before. He is a pretty good man. He comes to see me every year. No, this matter in his family is making a fuss now, so I called him and listened to his cry on the phone."

After a pause, the old man continued: "What I am thinking is that you are working in the underworld now. Go over and see if you can solve it. If you can't solve it, see if you can shake people from below. If it can be solved, will that guy Wang Jiyou be able to deprive you of the benefits?"

Wu Jiang listened to his grandfather's words, thought about it for a moment, and nodded in agreement.He was also quite curious as to what the devil could be that would pester the son of the richest man Wang. He had never heard that the son of the richest man Wang was a playboy.

"Okay, I'll call Wang Jiyou now." The old man didn't hesitate. He immediately took out his mobile phone, found Wang Jiyou's number, and dialed it directly.

This matter should be done sooner rather than later. The longer it is delayed, the more troublesome it will be.

"Wang Jiyou immediately sent a car to pick us up. He is also a dead horse and a living doctor. Xiao Jiang, when you get here, make it up randomly. Just say that when you were in school, you worshiped a Taoist priest as your master and learned some skills. Don't reveal the dirty things. Remember?"

Wu Jiang agreed immediately. He didn’t want to have his contribution points deducted again. Who knows if he would be punished more severely if he did it again, and there would be no place to cry.

Within twenty minutes, the car sent by the Wang family arrived. It was Boss Wang's exclusive car, a black Maybach, low-key and luxurious.

The driver got out of the car respectfully, walked quickly to the door, politely helped the old man to the back seat, and respectfully asked Wu Jiang to get in the car.

Wu Jiang didn't care much and got directly into the passenger seat. Along the way, he chatted with the driver all the time. He originally wanted to take the opportunity to ask about the situation of the Wang family, but who knew that the driver was very strict. No matter how Wu Jiang made insinuations, he was just vague.

When Wu Jiang saw this, he didn't ask any more questions. He simply leaned back on the chair and closed his eyes to rest.
